patthana9.15:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesasampayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:3.1: na kilesavippayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesaṃ ceva na asaṃkilesikaṃ ca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:4.1: na asaṃkilesikaṃ ceva na no ca
patthana9.15:5.1: na kilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesaṃ ceva na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ceva na no ca kilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesaṃ ceva na kilesavippayuttaṃ ca na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:6.1: na kilesavippayuttaṃ ceva na no ca
patthana9.15:7.1: kilesaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesavippayuttaṃ na saṃkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kilesavippayuttaṃ na asaṃkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:9.1: pahātabbahetukaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na savitakkaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na avitakkaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na savicāraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:11.1: avicāraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sappītikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:13.1: appītikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na pītisahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:15.1: pītisahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sukhasahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na
patthana9.15:16.1: sukhasahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na upekkhāsahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:18.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na kāmāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana9.15:20.1: kāmāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na rūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na rūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na arūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na na arūpāvacaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na apariyāpannaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na niyyānikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na aniyyānikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na niyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na aniyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sauttaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na anuttaraṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.15:21.1: na araṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. araṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na kusalo ca na araṇo na kusalo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana9.15:22.1: na saraṇaṃ na kusalañca na araṇaṃ na kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.15:24.1: na saraṇaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.15:26.1: na na saraṇaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana9.15:27.1: na araṇaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
